text.p: These were the headlines on Estonian Kuku radio at noon. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- Preliminary economic indicators from the finance ministry show the total economic growth in 1996 was stable and proceded as predicted.
- Lithuanian bank Litimpex is holding talks with Estonia's Hoiupank. Hoiupank is seeking a controlling stake in Lithuanian bank.
- World leading pharmaceuticials producer Bristol Meyer Squibb is opening a warehouse in Tallinn on Thursday. This will be the first and only such warehouse in the Baltic states.
